subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Each member of the literary club submitted various literary works for the magazine.

options.text: Various literary works had been submitted by each member of the literary club for the magazine.
Various literary works are submitted by each member of the literary club for the magazine.
Various literary works were submitted by each member of the literary club for the magazine.
Various literary works were being submitted by each member of the literary club for the magazine.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Various literary works were submitted by each member of the literary club for the magazine.**
